stations.title: Odette
stations.say: Why is an error up as a show?

stations.title: Listings screen
stations.text: Reads the body and nothing else.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Says how it went before the body starts.

captions: Odette sees a sentence about a missing show up on the listings screen.
The screen reads only the body, so a not found answer looks like a show.
You read the status line, a header, and the whole answer at once.
Now the screen sees that midnight-quiz is not on, and says so.
Every answer says how it went first. Now the screen reads that part too.
